1. personal-web.js starts
        ↓
2. Services are loaded
        ↓
3. Service cards are created
        ↓
4. Order buttons are placed on page
        ↓
5. setupCart() runs
        ↓
6. cart.js can now find the Order buttons

Order button
     ↓
Get service ID
     ↓
Find service
     ↓
Add service to cart array
     ↓
Console shows cart

personal-web.js
    ↓
Displays services
    ↓
Creates Order buttons


cart.js
    ↓
Receives clicks
    ↓
Finds selected services
    ↓
Stores them in cart
    ↓
Updates cart quantity


**

let cartQuantity = 0;
const cartQuantityElement = document.querySelector('.js-cart-quantity');

function updateCartQuantity () {
  cartQuantityElement.innerHTML = cartQuantity;
}

document.querySelectorAll('.order-button[data-service-id]').forEach((button) => {
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    cartQuantity += 1;
    updateCartQuantity();
  });
});

updateCartQuantity();

**

export let cart = [];

const cartQuantityElement = document.querySelector('.js-cart-quantity');

function updateCartQuantity () {
  cartQuantityElement.innerHTML = cart.length;
}

document.querySelectorAll('.order-button[data-service-id]').forEach((button) => {
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const serviceId = button.dataset.serviceId;

    const selectedService = services.find((service) => {
      return service.id === serviceId;
    });

    cart.push(selectedService);

    updateCartQuantity();

  });

});

updateCartQuantity();
